description: Prompt-injection detection for untrusted text (web pages, emails, documents, tool output) before it reaches an LLM; a guardrail for agent pipelines. Flags instruction overrides, role spoofing, secret/system-prompt exfiltration, image beacons, tool-call markup, hidden Unicode, hidden HTML and base64 payloads. Returns a 0-100 risk score, risk level and matched rules. Deterministic rules, no LLM. JSON body {text}, max 32 KB. Errors: 400 missing text, 413 too large. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: POST /v1/text/injection-scan.
name: injection_scan
title: Prompt-injection pre-filter
